quarterly_data.signal: Eversource's 10-K projects capital expenditures of $26.51 billion from 2026 through 2030, of which $11.24 billion is expected in the electric distribution segment and $7.24 billion in the electric transmission segment (the rest in natural gas distribution and information technology and facilities). Consolidated capital expenditures were $4.61 billion in 2025, $4.64 billion in 2024 and $4.59 billion in 2023, and electric transmission capital expenditures decreased by $118.8 million in 2025 versus 2024.
